opening.argument: The materials promote downloadable cryptocurrency trading software and connect it to a password-protected archive, giving viewers a direct action tied to the advertised bot. The title calls it a “Free Sniper Bot,” while the description supplies a download link and password and states that it supports multiple decentralized exchanges. The accompanying description also associates the software with cryptocurrency trading and bot implementation. The visible materials show the branded bot alongside exchange and token-chart interfaces, and direct viewers to a website and Telegram contacts. These facts establish a trading-bot promotion, although they do not establish the software’s functionality, destination behavior, completed transactions, losses, or the legitimacy of those contacts.
